title: Executive Flight
description: Intercept unencrypted radio traffic from the private hangar's ground-control panel.

hints: The passcode begins with the number of shot glasses in the display case.
The second digit is the number of Slinkys on display on the upstairs bookshelf.
The third digit is the number of televisions (not monitors) to be found in this house.

config.instruction: The hangar terminal is logging flight data. Download the audio intercepts, or skim fuel supply credits.
